deer-mountain-national-recreat.name: Deer Mountain
deer-mountain-national-recreat.seasonality: Snow-free late June–September on the upper mountain
deer-mountain-national-recreat.summary: The island's signature climb from downtown to the Deer Mountain ridge. Usable today; the gap is what happens after the summit.

carlanna-lake.name: Carlanna Lake
carlanna-lake.summary: Existing trail from the Carlanna neighborhood to Carlanna Lake. A built mile on the downtown-to-Ward spine.

connell-lake.name: Connell Lake
connell-lake.summary: Existing USFS trail at Connell Lake. The gap is getting here from Ward without walking the road.

dude-mountain-trail.name: Dude Mountain
dude-mountain-trail.summary: Existing climb above the north highway. A built destination waiting on a coastal connection that does not require a car.

lunch-creek.name: Lunch Creek
lunch-creek.summary: Existing USFS trail at Lunch Creek. The northern anchor of the Ward-to-interior corridor.

perseverance-trail.name: Perseverance Trail
perseverance-trail.whatItNeeds: Brushing, tread repair, and a current condition walk with the Forest Service.
perseverance-trail.summary: A historic connection north of town. It exists, but sections are brushed over and the tread is uneven — a built mile that does not yet carry the network.

pipeline-trail.name: Pipeline Trail
pipeline-trail.summary: Existing trail in the Ward drainage. One of the pieces already on the ground between town and the lake.

salvage-trail.name: Salvage Trail
salvage-trail.whatItNeeds: Corridor clearing and a decision on whether this remains a local trail or a network link.
salvage-trail.summary: Exists but is degraded. Not yet assigned to a priority corridor.

silvis-lake.name: Silvis Lake
silvis-lake.summary: Existing trail to Silvis Lake on the south island. The missing piece is a ridge connection from Deer Mountain.

ward-creek.name: Ward Creek
ward-creek.summary: Existing trail along Ward Creek. The built start of the northbound interior corridor.

ward-lake-nature-trail.name: Ward Lake Nature Trail
ward-lake-nature-trail.summary: The accessible loop at Ward Lake. The destination at the north end of the downtown spine.

naha-river-national-recreation.name: Naha River
naha-river-national-recreation.summary: Existing National Recreation Trail at the north end of the island. Not on a Phase 1 priority corridor; it shows how far the built network already reaches.

minerva-mountain.name: Minerva Mountain
minerva-mountain.summary: Existing high-country trail. A built mile that is not yet tied to a named corridor.

frog-pond-trail.name: Frog Pond
frog-pond-trail.summary: Short existing USFS trail. Kept on the map because residents already use it.

gokachin-trail.name: Gokachin
gokachin-trail.summary: Existing USFS trail on the island network inventory.

white-river-nordic-trail.name: White River Nordic
white-river-nordic-trail.summary: Existing nordic trail near the Harriet Hunt / White River area.

orchard-lake-trail.name: Orchard Lake
orchard-lake-trail.summary: Existing USFS trail at Orchard Lake.

ella-lake.name: Ella Lake
ella-lake.summary: Existing USFS trail at Ella Lake.

manzanita-lake.name: Manzanita Lake
manzanita-lake.summary: Existing USFS trail at Manzanita Lake.

margaret-trail.name: Margaret Trail
margaret-trail.summary: Existing USFS trail in the Margaret drainage.

low-lake-big-lake.name: Low Lake / Big Lake
low-lake-big-lake.summary: Existing USFS trail between Low Lake and Big Lake.
